formulas.ascii: The connectivity floor is the maximum nearest-other-row distance. Repeated locations have zero nearest distance; a separate distinct-location search preserves nonzero spacing. The bounded summary also retains extent, centre, spread and rank-distance quantiles. This fixture uses all five planar locations, including one duplicate.
